ios.desc:
Check in. Earn Rewards. GetBetter.

Get rewarded for the workouts you're already doing.

Add the gyms and studios you already visit, open GetBetter. when you work out, and check in. Stay consistent throughout your 30-day challenge and earn rewards for showing up.

GetBetter. helps you build a healthier lifestyle through real-world activity, community, accountability, and rewards.

Discover 100,000+ gyms and studios, check in using geolocation, track your activity, join challenges, and connect with people who motivate you.
Whether you're lifting at the gym, taking a fitness class, going for a run, playing in a volleyball league, or simply getting your daily walk in, GetBetter. brings your healthy lifestyle together in one place.

Features:
• Discover 100,000+ gyms and studios
• Check in at the places you already work out
• Join 30-day check-in challenges
• Earn rewards for staying consistent
• Track runs and walks with route maps
• Connect with Apple Health
• Track steps, workouts, and daily progress
• Create workout and nutrition plans
• Share your progress with friends
• Join leagues, groups, and community challenges
• Compete on leaderboards and player rankings
• Discover nearby workouts, sports, and activities
• Build your personal health profile

GetBetter. is designed around one simple idea: Do something every day to get better.
